entries.0920a3fded5a7bc2: DDS stands for disk drive suspension, and it is a business that makes the components supporting the magnetic head inside HDDs (hard disk drives) and probe units for semiconductor inspection. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥126,753 million.
entries.092a3adde6bdb9ee: This business makes iron cores for motors used in electric vehicles and other applications (motor cores), thin-plate springs, wire springs, screws, and mechanism parts for HDDs. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥105,612 million. Following its base in Mexico, the company has decided to invest in setting up motor core production capacity at its India base as well.
entries.1da19f9373d17bae: A parts manufacturer that makes and sells automotive springs and seats, and components for HDDs and semiconductors, around the world.
entries.474df66b5e0f5247: This business manufactures automotive seats, seat mechanism components, interior parts and the like, and is the largest of the 5 reportable segments by revenue. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥292,561 million. Its strengths are an in-house system covering the main processes, such as metal processing, urethane and sewing, and its design and development capability for finished seats, including seats that reduce carsickness.
entries.add36571078309c1: This business manufactures springs that support the automobile body and improve ride comfort, and is the starting point of the company. It handles coil springs, leaf springs, stabilizers (parts that suppress the tilting of the vehicle body), and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥167,417 million.
entries.e9d08e87c60bac7a: This is a business that makes a wide range of products for uses other than automobiles, such as semiconductor process components, ceramic products, piping support devices, parking systems, metal substrates and golf shafts. Group companies responsible for product sales and transportation are also included here. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥124,535 million.
